tripToProduct.text: Travelling solo through Uttarakhand to the Valley of Flowers.
Planning meant jumping between blogs, reels and forums, and almost none of it talked about travelling responsibly.
One place for travellers: guides, eco-tourism, community and practical tools.
Safarnama, which went on to win the Special Jury Award.
